shared_elements: incised linear marks on a wall surface
repeated geometric motifs arranged in a band or row
circular/disc forms (rosettes in A, circles in B)
horizontal register lines dividing the surface
justification: Both surfaces carry incised marks organised with horizontal dividing lines and include round forms (a row of rosettes below A's scene, small circles in B), plus repeated small units in a band. But A depicts a naturalistic figural scene — a horse in profile drawing a spoked-wheel chariot with a driver holding reins — while B shows only abstract scratched graffiti: crosshatched lozenges, vertical strokes, ladder-like signs and angular marks, with no figures, animals or objects at all.
